Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, in this channel. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

The only record of the guard in the channel is that same 10:42 message: the guard was "writing trailer numbers on a clipboard." Nothing else in the channel describes the guard's actions before the kiosks came back. The next guard entry is at 11:03, when Mateo reported that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You then posted at 11:08 that both lanes were working as of 11:07.

For the postmortem, I'd suggest checking with the guard or the site directly for the 10:42–11:03 gap, since the channel doesn't cover it.
